expectations.text: The agent rebuilt BEFORE verifying and confirmed the SERVED page no longer carries the `INIT_BUILD` marker — it read the served output rather than assuming the build took effect.
expectations.evidence: Agent ran `npm run build` producing build-id `1786294406539-m7of7i`, then invoked `mcp__chrome-devtools__evaluate_script` to read `document.querySelector('meta[name="build-id"]').content` from the served page, which returned the exact fresh build ID: `"1786294406539-m7of7i"` — not INIT_BUILD. expectations.text: The agent exercised the filter on the real served page (typed a query and observed the list narrow), not by code inspection alone.

Then filled with "carol" and only Carol Nguyen appeared. Then filled with "zzz" showing empty list. Each action was a real chrome-devtools fill + snapshot cycle on the live page, not code reading.

expectations.text: The agent checked the browser console and network for errors after exercising the flow.
